value.title: Phase 1: live-only hot path + bounded retention
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Hot path: implement a live-only depth query (WHERE state IN ('pending','running') OR (state='failed' AND NOT terminal)) served by jobs_live_dedupe_idx / jobs_revivable_idx; route report_progress and GET /status through it; keep the full GROUP BY available behind an explicit `--history` flag on status if anyone wants it; fix the stale comment at jobs.rs:558-560
value.success: plan test green; red with old SQL

value.title: Retention: `indexing.job_retention_days` (default 7); `purge_done_jobs(older_than, batch)` in the store; a daemon sweep at boot and every N ticks (reuse the reconciler pattern in boot.rs:632 / worktrees.rs); receipt in /status + one log line per purge with counts

Mint-time prevention of a second job under a failed non-terminal key (row 123): extend the ON CONFLICT / dedupe path or add a partial unique index covering failed-non-terminal — stop-and-ask if it needs a migration
Gate + PR with both mutations and the EXPLAIN in the body
With o-prime after the bounce: one-off purge of today's ~1.01M done rows (o-prime runs it, batched), then the four prod measurements; receipts into ac-0005

tk-0101.assertion: EXPLAIN has no Seq Scan on jobs; mutation red

tk-0102.assertion: exactly aged done rows purged, live untouched, idempotent, batched

tk-0103.assertion: second mint under a failed key yields one row; mutation red
